'''Mead''' is the preservation of [[Honey|honey]]. It heals {{Hp|6}} and grants {{EffectLink|Speed}} for 5 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/mead.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A honey bottle, a brown mushroom, sugar and sweet berries, an apple or glow berries. Picking up a honey bottle unlocks the recipe.
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Drinking mead takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|6}} and gives Speed I (+20% speed) for 5:00. It gives the glass bottle back when eaten.
